Binary: ROC AUC, PR AUC, balanced accuracy, Brier score, sensitivity and specificity at the frozen validation threshold. Save: test_metrics.csv (metric, value, ci_low, ci_high).
Record: the exact declared primary_metric name on test with ci; fact test_roc_auc only for the corresponding test AUC, citing test_metrics.csv.

Use exactly that list in every step, and never let a target or excluded column reach a fitted transformer or model.

Inspect feature_names_in_ for each loaded object and preserve its exact input columns and order. [RL-0014] When repairing, read the error type and message in the diagnostics first and change the smallest part of the script that causes it; keep the approach, inputs and outputs. Later steps pass the declared source feature schema to the saved pipeline, never assume derived columns already exist in a freshly loaded partition.
